cases.name: Molly Nicole Watson
cases.about: Worked at Burrell Behavioral Center in Moberly, MO.
cases.narrative: On 4/27/2018, a passing motorist discovered her lifeless body lying in front of her vehicle in a remote area near Route M and Highway 151 outside of Middle Grove, MO. Her marriage certificate was on the passenger seat of the car. He shot her in the back of the head 2 days before they were supposed to get married - though he was already married and had been for 22 years.
